dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, do you study every day?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, duː juː ˈstʌdi ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I usually study at night.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ˈstʌdi ət ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, I never study on the weekend. I work.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, aɪ ˈnɛvər ˈstʌdi ɑːn ðə ˈwiːkɛnd. aɪ ˈwɜːrk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown always works on Saturday.
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn ˈɔːlweɪz ˈwɜːrks ɑːn ˈsætərdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, and he sometimes works on Sunday, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ənd hiː ˈsʌmtaɪmz ˈwɜːrks ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ, ˈtuː.
